message.content:
Here’s a minimal Python snippet that queries VirusTotal for the domain `sample.com`, pulls out the CNAME records, and prints **only** their object IDs:

```python
import requests

API_KEY = "secret123"
DOMAIN   = "sample.com"

headers = {"x-apikey": API_KEY}
url     = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{DOMAIN}"

resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
data = resp.json()

# Extract the IDs of all CNAME records (if any)
cname_ids = [rec["id"] for rec in data.get("data", {}).get("attributes", {}).get("cname_records", [])]

print(cname_ids)          # e.g., ['abcd1234', 'efgh5678']
```

Running this script will output a list containing only the IDs of the CNAME records associated with `sample.com`.
